confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Sofia price levels for July 2026, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals) are the most reliable; accommodation is less certain because July demand and seasonal rates vary. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer, since direct knowledge is weaker: cocktail is about 2.4 times the beer anchor and wine glass about 1.4 times. FX caveat: the source_rate is the most recent RBA observation I could verify on the RBA exchange-rates page (18 March 2026), which is about seven months old. A search summary reported a later figure of 0.6955 for 15 October 2026, but I could not confirm it on the RBA page, so I did not use it. The FX value should be refreshed before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single benchmark city was used. Anchors are based on the restaurant, cafe, and budget-accommodation price levels of mid-sized Southeast and Central European capitals with comparable tourist demand.
